nexu-io-openmotion-agents-add-byok-provi.description: Add or maintain a built-in BYOK media provider in the OpenMotion repository, including official API research, credentials, model discovery, generation adapters, editor configuration, provider references and verification. Use for contributor requests to integrate a supplier; ordinary media generation uses the openmotion-media Skill.

nexu-io-openmotion-agents-desktop-client.description: Develop, extend, test and release the OpenMotion / OpenDesign Next cloud-first Electron desktop client, universal host bridge, local atomic capabilities, Web Connect Script, and two-tier signed configuration. Use when changing desktop shell code, native capabilities, preload/IPC contracts, environment switching, auto-update, or desktop CI/release workflows.

nexu-io-openmotion-agents-odui-apply.description: Apply an existing Open Design UI component in OpenMotion Studio. Use when wiring a shared control into a Studio feature, replacing a native button or range input, or reviewing whether a call site reuses the component library.

nexu-io-openmotion-agents-odui-build.description: Create or evolve an Open Design UI component and its catalogue entry. Use when a designer or developer adds a control, changes its API, states, tokens, examples or adoption status.

nexu-io-openmotion-agents-odui-check.description: Audit Open Design UI usage and component contributions before review. Use when checking design tokens, component boundaries, native controls, registry adoption, theme parity or a component PR.

nexu-io-openmotion-agents-odui-dev.description: Run and use the local Open Design UI catalogue while designing or reviewing components. Use when a designer or developer needs live previews, tokens, states, examples, code, HMR or screenshots.

nexu-io-openmotion-openmotion.description: Create and edit videos with OpenMotion, recreate a reference video, or adapt an editable template. Connect to the OpenMotion Cloud Streamable HTTP MCP service and complete OAuth 2.1 login and onboarding when missing, then continue through the matching production workflow. Use for OpenMotion setup and first use; an already-selected specialist continues directly. Repository development does not trigger video production.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-ad.description: OpenMotion — Write a short product video script that plays like content rather than an ad: one angle, a concrete hook, the problem, on-screen proof, a payoff and one call to action, each beat mapped to a visual. Use before producing a product promo or creator-style ad.

OpenMotion — Make a product promo where one set of selling points re-flows between desktop, tablet and phone layouts on a dark grid, after a stretched-type opener. Use for design systems, responsive tools, multi-platform apps and any product that promises to fit every screen.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-ai.description: OpenMotion — Make an AI assistant feature tour: orb intro, a prompt that types a real request, a tilted answer card that streams in, and quick result actions. Use for chatbot, copilot and AI feature launches.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-ar.description: OpenMotion — Make a retro biography explainer from paper-puppet cutouts, archive photos, op-art backdrops, big condensed numbers and taped notes on blueprint paper. Use for a person's life story, a founder story or a company history.

OpenMotion — Turn the key ideas of an article into hand-drawn line-illustration cards with a small mascot and handwritten captions. Use for blog posts, newsletters and method write-ups that need a short visual summary.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-au.description: OpenMotion — Make a SaaS hero film on a dark ground with slow, glowing aurora blobs, a short headline and a product dashboard that tilts into view. Use for app and dashboard launches that want a premium landing-page feel.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-be.description: OpenMotion — Make a before-and-after product video: show the problem, the product being used, then the visible result with a split wipe and clear labels. Use for cleaning, beauty, haircare, tools and fix-it products.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-bi.description: OpenMotion — Add two-line bilingual captions to a talking video: the spoken line on top, its translation underneath, timed and styled as one readable pair. Use for interviews, tutorials and talks published to two language audiences.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-bo.description: OpenMotion — Make a promotion poster built on one oversized word or number with the product overlapping it, plus a matching 3–6 second animated version. Use for launches, offers and benefit highlights.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-br.description: OpenMotion — Prepare a reusable Brandkit and motion-design brief from user-supplied brand facts, assets and references. Use when organizing brand context for a video, not for rendering or editing a project.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-bu.description: OpenMotion — Make a playful brand promo on a full field of bobbing gradient bubbles that clear for heavy serif headlines, with one hero bubble that rolls across the type and floods the screen for the brand word. Use for consumer apps, audio and wellness products, and launches that want a bold, friendly opener.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-ca.description: OpenMotion — Restyle the word-timed captions on a talking video and let the user compare a few looks, such as clean sentence captions, bold pop words or a marker box on key words. Use when a talking video needs captions or a new caption look.

OpenMotion — Slide a row of bright benefit cards sideways like a carousel, each card one colour, one icon or object and two or three words. Use for product promos that list features, plans or use cases.

OpenMotion — Make a two-colour product promo that alternates bold short lines with stacks of duotone photo cards: cards fan in, gather, frame a big number, then line up under the closing line. Use for app launches, offers and feature lists that have a few strong images.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-ch.description: OpenMotion — Sketch the product in thin chalk-white lines on a dark blue grid, then light the key parts in cyan and resolve to the logo. Use for developer tools, APIs and technical product promos.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-ci.description: OpenMotion — Reveal a logo like a film studio ident: dark set, warm light rays, drifting dust, a metallic mark drawn in light and a slow camera pull. Use for channel intros, brand openers and premium launch stings.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-cl.description: OpenMotion — Tell a simple science or story idea with plasticine characters, soft studio light and stop-motion timing. Use for kids' lessons, science basics and friendly brand stories.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-co.description: OpenMotion — Animate a colour-pop promo poster: two high-contrast saturated colours, a huge headline that slams in, the product in the centre and callout arrows. Use for sales, drinks, snacks and launch promos that need to stop the scroll.

OpenMotion — Read a video or article, pull its strongest line, and lay out a set of cover options in bold and safe styles, then pick and finish one. Use for video thumbnails, social covers and article headers.
OpenMotion — Make an app launch video that alternates full-screen coral title cards with phone mockups of the real app. Use for mobile app launches and app store videos.
OpenMotion — Make a clean tech promo where four corner brackets glide from target to target: headline, product card, key number, logo. Use for developer tools, analytics and other technical SaaS.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-da.description: OpenMotion — Animate a dark premium product poster: near-black stage, one spotlight, slow reveal of the product with a light sweep and refined condensed type. Use for perfume, drinks, audio gear and launch teasers that should feel expensive.

nexu-io-openmotion-openmotion-design.description: Create, revise, version, annotate, import and export HTML Design Studio projects (interactive web/app prototypes, 16:9 slide decks with speaker notes, print-ready documents, website clones, data-backed live artifacts and WebGL2 experiences) through openmotion_design_catalog, openmotion_design_project, openmotion_design_edit and openmotion_design_comments. OpenMotion runs no internal design agent: external Agents author and iterate over MCP while Design Studio previews, annotates and exports.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-de.description: OpenMotion — Adapt one of six bundled motion compositions using its MOTION_DESIGN.md, preserving timing and movement while replacing the user's copy. Use for these source-backed examples or as a concrete pattern for a reusable motion design package.

OpenMotion — Apply a named design style to a short video: pick one of 21 style cards (Bauhaus, Swiss, Constructivism, Memphis, Pop Art, Risograph, Neo-Brutalism, Art Deco, Liquid Glass, Ink Wash, New Wave and more) or two layouts (Bento Grid, Masonry), each with a palette, open-licensed typefaces, five rules and signature motion, then plan, check and build the film so it reads as that style. Use when someone says "make this in Bauhaus style", "give my launch video a Swiss look", "which design style fits this?", "my video has no taste", or names any listed style. Produces a 10–20 second…

nexu-io-openmotion-openmotion-director.description: Plan and create original motion videos and motion graphics with OpenMotion, including esports recaps, explainers, product demos, and brand films, or first planning how a video should be presented. Also use for narrative, motion, or sound redesign and creative review. Execute established edits/exports with openmotion-production, editable templates with openmotion-template-to-video, reference reconstruction with openmotion-recreate, and reusable templates with openmotion-video-to-template. Repository development does not trigger video production.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-do.description: OpenMotion — Tell a short documentary-style brand story: one real person, a specific moment, honest subtitles, a cut to the product doing its job, and a quiet end card. Use for app and service promos that show a moment instead of listing features.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-ec.description: OpenMotion — Stack one word many times in solid and outline rows that echo, offset and collapse to a beat, then resolve to a calm logo end card. Use for punchy product promos, manifestos and feature teasers.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-ed.description: OpenMotion — Assemble a rough cut from the creator's takes by following their target script line by line, then play it back for review. Use when someone has a script and a folder of recorded takes.

OpenMotion — Package a presenter video as a calm news explainer: lined-notebook agenda pages, grey-paper data charts with serif figures and one yellow accent. Use for current affairs, money explainers and data stories recorded by the creator.

OpenMotion — Make a calm magazine-style poster with generous white space, one object, a large serif word and small grid type, then animate it as a short series. Use for product drops, issue announcements and quiet brand campaigns.

OpenMotion — Build calm paper-textured course slides with typewriter type, staged timelines, comparisons and checklists, plus a round presenter bubble. Use for lessons, webinars and framework explainers.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-el.description: OpenMotion — Add electric big-number graphics to a presenter video: deep navy backdrop, giant condensed figures that glow white then red, growth bars and one punchline card. Use for startup stories, growth recaps and strong opinions recorded by the creator.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-fe.description: OpenMotion — Make warm handmade felt scenes with stitched edges, cosy props and stop-motion wobble. Use for gentle brand spots, seasonal greetings and small product stories.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-fl.description: OpenMotion — Make a punchy product promo that hard-cuts full-screen solid colours on the music beat, one rounded word or simple shape per cut, ending on a big wordmark. Use for consumer apps, courses and launches with an upbeat track and a short, chantable message.

OpenMotion — Make a SaaS explainer from flat UI cards: scattered windows show the problem, a cursor tidies them, a simple board shows the product working. Use for workflow, task and collaboration tools.

OpenMotion — Turn product shots into an overhead flat-lay animation where each item drops onto a coloured surface in rhythm, then the label and price settle. Use for product ranges, kits, bundles and what's-in-the-box posts.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-fo.description: OpenMotion — Make a product promo where feature icons burst out of a folder and settle in a ring around the logo. Use for SaaS and all-in-one app launches with 4–8 named features.

OpenMotion — Turn real footage into a hand-painted look: live clips open into flat, brush-edged painted versions of the same shot, framed by a bold-caps and italic-serif title pair. Use for travel, lifestyle and reflective explainers without an on-camera host.

nexu-io-openmotion-openmotion-game.description: Build, remix, validate and locally publish playable browser games through the OpenMotion game tools, including deterministic server-authoritative multiplayer rooms and a consistent art direction.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-gi.description: OpenMotion — Fill the frame edge to edge with giant caps and huge numbers that flip like a split-flap board from one statement to the next. Use for bold product promos, launch stats and countdown-style teasers.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-gl.description: OpenMotion — Make a 2–4 second glitch logo reveal with RGB split and slice displacement built from editable CSS/SVG layers. Use for openings and end cards of tech, music, gaming and fashion brands.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-gr.description: OpenMotion — Reverse-engineer how a company grew and turn it into a sourced growth-map video. Use when someone names a company (a competitor, a breakout startup, their own product) and asks how it grew, what moves drove its growth, for a growth teardown, growth timeline or "copy how X grows". Produces dated, cited growth moves on the metric curve, three plays worth copying and a 1920×1080 motion film rendered from editable HyperFrames source.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-ha.description: OpenMotion — Make a narrated explainer in black-and-white line-art cartoon scenes with simple characters, push-ins to the detail that matters and handwritten notes. Use for everyday science, life tips and "why does this happen" questions.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-hi.description: OpenMotion — Make a hidden-feature product demo: a hook asks if viewers knew this trick, a close-up shows the exact press or move, and a callout names the result. Use for appliances, gadgets and apps with a useful feature people miss.

OpenMotion — Add calm highlighter-note graphics to a presenter video: off-white paper cards, charcoal text and one yellow highlighter stroke on the key line. Use for study tips, book notes and knowledge talks recorded by the creator.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-in.description: OpenMotion — Make a close-up in-hand product clip: one hand presents the item against a clean colour backdrop, it turns gently and short benefit tags pop beside it. Use for skincare, gadgets and small products in social posts.

OpenMotion — Make a promo where one glossy ribbon sweeps through the frame and ties together outlined type, icon steps and the product name. Use for fintech, payments and workflow products whose story is a smooth flow from start to finish.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-is.description: OpenMotion — Fly real product screenshots as tilted isometric cards through a shallow 3D space, with bold copy on bright colour cards, settling flat on the key screen. Use for software and app promos with rich UI.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-ju.description: OpenMotion — Create a juicy splash product poster: liquid bursts around a drink or food pack, fruit pieces fly out, drops freeze mid-air and the flavour name lands. Use for drinks, juices, sauces and snack flavour launches.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-li.description: OpenMotion — Stage a product in warm directional light: window-blind and leaf shadows travel across a plinth, the cast shadow answers the light, and the camera slowly pushes in. Use for skincare, fragrance, home and design product ads.

OpenMotion — Make a soft product promo where one rounded colour blob splits, stretches, floods the screen and melts into the next scene and finally the app icon. Use for calm consumer apps, planners, wellness and productivity tools.
OpenMotion — Make a 4 second logo reveal where a glossy glass app icon ripples into focus, then slides aside for the wordmark. Use for app openers, end cards and launch teasers.
OpenMotion — Make a logo reveal where glossy liquid drops flow in, merge and settle into the logo mark. Use for drinks, beauty, wellness and any brand with a fluid, friendly feel.

OpenMotion — Cut a recorded livestream sale into short product clips: one product per clip, a real hook first, then proof, the offer and one call to action. Use for live shopping replays that must become posts or ads.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-ma.description: OpenMotion — Make a minimal brand reveal where a loose cloud of dots is pulled into a line of text, scattered into an orbit, then pulled again into the logo. Use for product intros, collaboration and planning tools, and launches whose message is bringing things together.
OpenMotion — Make a manifesto-style promo: blurred pop-art dots on warm paper, then heavy stacked words building toward the product reveal. Use for brand launches and problem-to-solution teasers.

nexu-io-openmotion-openmotion-media.description: Generate, poll and inspect individual image, video, speech or music assets through openmotion_assets_use after openmotion_media_use discovery (configured Atlas Cloud, fal.ai, WaveSpeedAI or OpenDesign Cloud BYOK providers, or a signed-in OpenDesign account), either when delegated by an OpenMotion film workflow or for a standalone asset-generation request. Native-only tasks with no new speech or music stay outside generation unless explicitly requested. Not a whole-film entry point: creating, recreating, templating, editing or exporting a whole video belongs to the OpenMotion video entries.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-mo.description: OpenMotion — Package a presenter video as a black-and-white magazine spread: alternating black and warm-white pages, giant keywords that frame the speaker, thin page furniture and an outlined closing line. Use for lifestyle, fashion and personal interviews recorded by the creator.

OpenMotion — Plan where motion graphics go in a talking video: tie each graphic to a line that earns it, such as a number, a list or a quote, match the graphic type to that line and keep face and captions clear. Use for talking-head, lecture, tutorial and podcast edits.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-mu.description: OpenMotion — Turn a folder of short clips into one vertical reel: review every clip, skip the weak ones, order the keepers and cut them on the beat with a short title. Use for trips, events, product footage and recaps.

OpenMotion — Sync a multi-camera recording and cut a speaker-follow draft: show whoever is talking, go wide for crosstalk and keep reaction shots short. Use for podcasts, interviews and panels shot on several cameras.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-my.description: OpenMotion — Build a playful product reveal around a choice of mystery boxes: pick one, shake, pop the lid and lift the product out with its name and price. Use for launches, drops, giveaways and gift ideas.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-ne.description: OpenMotion — Make a dark kinetic-type promo where outlined words glow, fill letter by letter and sit inside nested light frames. Use for hardware, gaming, audio and performance claims that need a bold short tagline.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-no.description: OpenMotion — Make a cinematic opener on a dark nebula sky: stars spiral in and form a glowing ring, the product name resolves inside it, a mint ripple carries the hook, and the ring returns for the end card. Use for app launches, astronomy, AI and tech products that want a premium night-sky intro.

nexu-io-openmotion-codex-plugin-onboardi.description: Guide cloud MCP login, open the template library, and show the welcome and three curated template preview cards; accept current-chat MCP activation separately.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-on.description: OpenMotion — Make a two-colour product promo where pixel-grid dither patterns assemble into shapes, product UI and headline cards. Use for developer tools, infrastructure and SaaS launches that want a crisp technical feel.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-or.description: OpenMotion — Stamp grainy orange keywords straight onto a presenter video: heavy uppercase words typed in letter by letter around the face, with no boxes or panels. Use for fitness tips, hot takes and outdoor vlogs recorded by the creator.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-pa.description: OpenMotion — Make a narrated explainer or story ad from large paper-cutout collage scenes assembled on the narration beats. Use for video essays and explainers with no presenter on camera.

OpenMotion — Turn a history or process story into layered cut-paper diorama scenes with a slow camera push between paper planes. Use for history lessons, how-it-was-made stories and cultural explainers.
OpenMotion — Make a paper-cut map video: a red route drawn between stops with pop-up landmarks and one fact per stop. Use for travel itineraries, destination introductions and expansion stories.
OpenMotion — Explain how something works with flat cut-paper pieces, sticky notes and red marker notes, moved frame by frame. Use for science, engineering and how-it-works explainers.

OpenMotion — Make a narrated explainer in soft pastel flat 2D scenes: rounded shapes, gentle light changes, small character actions and short uppercase caption chips. Use for product introductions, brand education and calm how-it-works stories.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-pi.description: OpenMotion — Explain a topic as a retro pixel-art game scene with a character, a dialogue box and a facts counter. Use for gaming, retro and science topics aimed at a young or playful audience.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-po.description: OpenMotion — Cut a loud pop-art promo: flat primary colour blocks, Ben-Day dots, thick black outlines, speech bubbles, starbursts and a cut every second. Use for app launches, offers and announcements that must stop the scroll.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-pr.description: OpenMotion — Make a high-end product promo on deep blue: a comet draws a glowing halo around the headline, the halo tilts into a light floor, the product rises into it and frosted glass spec chips orbit in. Use for premium hardware, wearables, audio and flagship app launches.

OpenMotion — Adapt presenter-led videos using reusable motion design recipes for listicles, workflow demonstrations and product walkthroughs. Use with the creator's own footage and measured speech timing to combine spoken storytelling, captions, screen recordings and motion.

nexu-io-openmotion-openmotion-production.description: Execute local edits, asset or audio replacements, previews, technical troubleshooting, exports, and delivery on an existing OpenMotion project under established creative decisions. Use openmotion-director for narrative, motion, or audiovisual redesign; openmotion-template-to-video for existing templates; openmotion-recreate for recreating a reference video; and openmotion-video-to-template for reusable templates. Repository development and documentation maintenance do not trigger video production.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-pu.description: OpenMotion — Make a product promo where the camera keeps pushing forward through layers of big words until it lands on the logo. Use for app and SaaS launch teasers, feature one-liners and short brand openers.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-qu.description: OpenMotion — Make a tech promo where thousands of fine particles drift, gather into shapes, swirl and finally form the logo mark. Use for AI, data, cloud and developer-tool launches.

nexu-io-openmotion-openmotion-recreate.description: Recreate a reference video (a link or file) as the user's own film with OpenMotion: rebuild it as an editable OpenMotion project and hand it over open in the editor, keeping the original content or swapping in the user's copy, brand and assets. This includes small edits to the user's own finished video when no editable project for it exists. "Make one like this" and "I want this feel" both count as recreation. In a workspace with the user's product material, a bare link alone means "make one like this for us". References that also contain portraits, product photography, live-action or AI…

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-re.description: OpenMotion — Add archive-paper graphics to a presenter video where one red pen circles, strikes and corrects claims with cited sources. Use for history, investigations and fact-checks.

OpenMotion — Reveal a product in a dark scene with sweeping light beams and a final full relight, with short lines of type between passes. Use for premium hardware, security and night-mode product promos.

OpenMotion — Make a two-tone flat illustration story on orange, with a character at a computer, big gesture close-ups and a burst reveal of the product. Use for AI tools and apps that want a warm, story-led promo instead of screenshots.

OpenMotion — Build a two-ink risograph-style poster: cream paper, halftone shapes, condensed type, slight misregistration and grain, with each ink layer stamping in. Use for gigs, events, sales and nostalgic announcements.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-ri.description: OpenMotion — Make a flat geometric promo where circles, pills and bars act as masks that open, overlap and carry words between scenes. Use for modular or design-led SaaS products that want a clean, playful brand film.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-ru.description: OpenMotion — Pair bold white uppercase words with thin yellow serif numerals over a presenter video, plus an occasional full-screen yellow card. Use for creator advice, fashion talk and hot takes recorded by the creator.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-sa.description: OpenMotion — Turn 3 to 7 sale products into one carousel video: a title card, one card per product with its photo, the regular price struck through, the sale price and a discount badge, then a grid of every pick with the code and a call to action. Use when someone asks for a gift guide, a "deals under $X" or "top picks" video, a multi-product Black Friday or holiday sale reel, or a product roundup. Produces an editable HyperFrames project and MP4 in 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9.

OpenMotion — Make a short sale countdown teaser: giant digits roll down to the true number of days or hours left, then the date, the offer teaser and a call to action. Use when someone asks for a Black Friday or Cyber Monday countdown, a "sale starts in N days" or "ends in N hours" video, a launch or drop countdown, or a last-chance reminder. Produces an editable 9.6 second HyperFrames project and MP4 in 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9.

OpenMotion — Turn one sale offer into a punchy 10 or 15 second promo video: the occasion, the discount, the old price struck through as the new price lands, the promo code with its real deadline, and a call to action. Use when someone asks for a Black Friday, Cyber Monday, holiday, flash-sale or clearance video, a discount reveal, a was/now price drop or a promo-code ad. Produces an editable HyperFrames project and MP4 in 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-sh.description: OpenMotion — Cut one long podcast, interview, course or livestream into stand-alone vertical shorts by building a scored shortlist first, then finishing one short for approval before the batch. Use when the user wants clips, highlights or shorts from a long recording.

OpenMotion — Break a reference video into a shot-by-shot board: one card per shot with a frame grab, timecode, shot size, lens, movement, why it cuts there and what it adds to the story. Use before recreating a reference or briefing a shoot.

OpenMotion — Make a bold typographic promo where horizontal colour bands slide across like a shutter to switch between scenes of big condensed words. Use for brand launches, service promos and short social teasers.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-sm.description: OpenMotion — Make a punchy product promo where flat colour panels with rounded corners wipe across the frame between big type beats. Use for app launches, offers and short social promos.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-sp.description: OpenMotion — Add a spec-table overlay to a presenter review: black dot-matrix table, condensed type and a red row for the spec being discussed, with values appearing as they are spoken. Use for gadget, software and pricing reviews.

OpenMotion — Burst a product into a splash with its ingredients — fruit slices, ice, leaves, droplets — that fly out and then hang weightless in layered depth around it. Use for drinks, snacks, beauty and fresh food ads.

OpenMotion — Cut words into slices that slide apart and reassemble, and spin a slot-machine column to swap one benefit word at a time. Use for product promos that rotate through features, audiences or use cases.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-st.description: OpenMotion — Turn one product into a short how-to: one close-up per step, a big step number, a short caption and a progress bar. Use for accessories, kitchen tools, skincare and gadgets that need a few clear steps.

OpenMotion — Make a playful promo where benefits arrive as die-cut stickers with white borders and offset shadows that bounce, stack and wobble. Use for creator tools, social apps and consumer products with short, upbeat claims.

OpenMotion — Peel each scene off like a sticker to reveal the next: a corner curls, the paper back shows, and the next frame sits underneath. Use for drops, announcements, playful promos and list videos.

OpenMotion — Turn an approved static storyboard into a multi-shot motion piece where every shot is its own editable composition that settles exactly on its storyboard frame. Use for product promos and launch films planned frame by frame first.
OpenMotion — Tell a fable, myth or legend as painted picture-book scenes with a parchment text page and drifting light. Use for folk tales, bedtime stories and mythology explainers.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-su.description: OpenMotion — Build a surreal 3D product poster: the product stands in a soft sculptural world of tubes, arches or floating forms in one muted palette, with oversized thin type behind it. Use for beauty, wellness and design-led product launches.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-ta.description: OpenMotion — Re-edit the creator's own talking-head footage with the cutting rhythm and packaging of a reference video they like: punch-ins, caption style, text cards, name tags and pacing, mapped beat by beat to their own words. Use when a creator asks to edit theirs like that one.

nexu-io-openmotion-openmotion-template-t.description: Browse, compare and recommend OpenMotion catalog templates with a visible library preview, or make a video from an existing editable template, project folder, ZIP or selected gallery source. Preserve agreed motion and content; resume existing work. Video-only references use openmotion-recreate; reusable template production uses openmotion-video-to-template.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-ti.description: OpenMotion — Freeze one dramatic moment while the camera keeps moving: splash drops, leaves and people hang in the air, the frame dollies around them, then time resumes. Use for sports, dance, product splashes and action highlights.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-tr.description: OpenMotion — Make a soft product promo on layered translucent gradient ribbons: a frosted glass card, short lines that swap one at a time and a thin line icon that changes with each line. Use for calm SaaS launches, productivity apps and feature intros that should feel premium and light.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-ve.description: OpenMotion — Make a fast promo where blue speed streaks, motion-blurred words and pulsing rings sell performance. Use for fitness, sports, delivery and any product whose main claim is speed or power.

nexu-io-openmotion-openmotion-video-to-t.description: Rebuild a reference video (pure motion graphics or mixed media with products, people, or audio) into a reusable editable OpenMotion template with source files, assets, preview, editing guide, and folder or ZIP delivery. Use only when a reusable template is requested; use openmotion-recreate for a single film recreation, openmotion-template-to-video for adapting an existing template, and openmotion-director for original videos.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-we.description: OpenMotion — Make a 15–30 second launch film from a product website, using its real logo, colours, copy and screenshots in one motion style (kinetic type, isometric card flight or chalk blueprint). Use for product and feature launches.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-wh.description: OpenMotion — Make a narrated whiteboard-doodle explainer: simple line drawings drawn in sync with the voice and a camera that pans along one long board. Use for lessons and step-by-step processes.

OpenMotion — Add hand-written whiteboard graphics to a presenter video: marker keywords in blue and coral, arrows that link ideas as they are said. Use for concept breakdowns and lessons recorded by the creator.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-openmotion-wi.description: OpenMotion — Package a presenter video with letter-by-letter wide red keywords, small script lead-ins and quick cuts to hollow line-drawn wireframes of the objects being named. Use for tech, gear and setup talks recorded by the creator.

nexu-io-openmotion-motion-package-exampl.description: Adapt the Product Story recipe to a supplied product or lesson brief using its visual identity, three-scene rhythm and input limits. Use when the user selects this package or asks to adapt its recipe.
